title: Ellaz mode file
description: The one file a game names, in one of two shapes, told apart by `kind`: a FIGHT mode (no `kind` - the fight's and the crypt's files predate the second kind and stay as they are) points at an arena, a match ruleset and a cast, and a STAGE mode adds `stage` and `waves`; a TURN mode (`kind: "turn"`) points at a battle and a rules file. `seed` lives here and not in code so a replay is a mode file plus an input log. Exactly one branch must be clean: scripts/lib/schema.mjs's oneOf reports the errors of the branch whose `kind` matches, whole.

fightMode.description: A STAGE mode adds `stage` (its tuning file) and `waves` (its level design): every wave's spawns join the cast as one fixed roster, dormant until their wave and delay - at most 31 rows in all, because the hit mask is one bit per target. `stage` and `waves` come together or not at all; the validator subset cannot write that conditional, so data.test.ts and compile.ts both assert it.

seed.description: the whole state of the sim's rng; uint32

stage.description: a basename under ../stage/; present iff `waves` is

waves.description: the level design, in play order

turnMode.description: a turn battle: the battle file holds the grid, the field and the placements; the rules file every timing

seed.description: carried in the state; the turn machine draws nothing from it today

spawnEntry.description: an enemy that walks in `delayTicks` after its wave starts, from the `side` edge of the screen (1 right, -1 left), facing in. Always ai-controlled. Its x and z are the sim's to decide at spawn time (the stage file's spawn block), not authored here.

side.description: 1 or -1; data.test.ts asserts it, the subset has no enum

castEntry.description: `ai` is REQUIRED when control is "ai" and FORBIDDEN otherwise. The validator subset (scripts/lib/schema.mjs) has no if/then, so that conditional cannot be written here and is asserted by data.test.ts instead - watched failing in both directions before it was believed.

ai.description: a basename under ../ai/; see the conditional above

x.description: view px; inside the arena's sim.xMin..xMax

z.description: view px; inside the arena's sim.zMin..zMax

face.description: 1 or -1; data.test.ts asserts it, the subset has no enum
